text:
omar: quick Q from the pricing block — are trial rate limits identical to paid starter plans?

rina: short: no. trial keys get conservative RPS and concurrency plus smaller monthly token + embedding quotas. paid starter ramps those up automatically.

omar: are embeddings and generation counted from the same pool or separate buckets? customers keep asking.

lina: separate quota lines by default. we have a "pooled credits" promo flag for special bundles but that's opt-in and visible in the billing console.

marcus: what happens if a long-running job suddenly hits quota mid-job? we need a predictable error for SDKs.

rina: we return a 429 with body like: `{"error":"quota_exceeded","quota_type":"tokens","retry_after":int}`. for insufficient billing balance we surface 402 + `insufficient_funds`. SDKs should treat both as retriable only after human action for 402.

omar: can promo credits increase quota automatically? Our sales pilots want smooth onboarding.

lina: promo credits normally reduce invoice balance only. ops can apply a temporary quota top-up (manual workflow) when approved by sales. there's a change request process so we can audit it.

marcus: any auto-charge / auto-upgrade behavior? we must avoid surprise billing.

rina: we do NOT auto-upgrade trials. paid customers can opt into "auto-topup" for quota add-ons (opt-in). for enterprise/dedicated everything is negotiated.

omar: can we surface remaining quota programmatically? mobile team asked for a header.

lina: proposing an opt-in response header: `X-Redwood-Remaining-Quota: tokens=12345;embeddings=80`. plus a `/v1/usage` admin endpoint for detailed usage which requires admin scope. privacy note: header only on requests from the key owner, not public keys.

marcus: how do rate limits differ between Hosted and Dedicated?

rina: Hosted enforces per-key & region-level limits. Dedicated customers get cluster-level concurrency configured in contract; control plane still applies soft safety throttles to protect shared control plane resources.

omar: if a pilot's usage spikes, what's the recommended ops/playbook?

lina: steps: 1) raise quota via ops change request, 2) notify billing & solutions, 3) enable temporary alerting for that org, 4) document rollback threshold. we'll capture as onboarding checklist item.

all-hands-bot: Follow-ups created: #4819 docs:quota-headers-example, #4820 onboarding:quota-playbook, #4821 billing:promo-to-quota-flow

omar: one last nit: can we standardize the error payload keys across SDKs? small variance causes confusion.

rina: agreed. standard set: `error`, `retry_after`, `quota_type` (when relevant), and `detail` for human text. docs will include sample responses and a small retry-backoff snippet.

lina: adding note — usage endpoint will require admin scope and will redact org-level PII by default.

omar: perfect. thanks — that clears a lot for CS and product. :thumbsup:
